source_en: Whoa, whoa, whoa... Hold up, guy.⏎If I'm a lost kid, does that make you the big, bad wolf or something?⏎Some kinda monster who's gonna gobble me up?

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: "Monster," huh? Believe me, kid.⏎I've met my share of monsters.⏎I don't even come close.
source_slot: "Mostro", eh? Credimi, ragazzino,⏎di mostri ne ho visti parecchi.⏎Sono molto peggio di me.

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: I hate to break it to ya, but you should quit while you can.⏎Young folks shouldn't waste their lives out here tonight.⏎If anyone's gonna die, it should be old folks like us.
source_slot: Non vorrei dirtelo, ma è meglio se ti ritiri finché puoi.⏎I giovani come te non dovrebbero sprecare le proprie vite, stanotte.⏎Se deve morire qualcuno, che sia uno di noi vegliardi.

source_en: Tsurugi
source_slot: Tsurugi

source_en: Aw, gimme a break...⏎You can't be more than a couple years older than me!
source_slot: Oh, ma fammi il favore...⏎Avrai sì e no due anni in più di me!

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: Try and show some sense, kid. You should listen to those who came⏎before you, especially when they're only looking out for you.⏎Ah, well. If words won't get the message across, maybe fists will.
source_slot: Mostra un po' di buon senso, ragazzino. Ascolta chi ha più esperienza⏎di te, soprattutto se cerca di darti una mano.⏎Oh, beh... Se le parole non bastano, dovrò fartelo capire con i pugni.

source_en: Tsurugi

source_en: Ha ha ha!⏎Do I look like someone who gets a lot out of words? No, right?

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: I guess not. All right, then I'll just have to beat the explanation⏎into you nice and thoroughly so you understand. It might hurt a bit,⏎but I'm sure you'll thank me after you wake up in a nice, warm bed.
source_slot: No, in effetti. E va bene, allora dovrò piantarti il concetto in testa⏎colpo su colpo finché non lo capisci per bene. Farà un po' male,⏎ma mi ringrazierai quando ti sveglierai al calduccio in un letto.

source_en: Sounds good to me! Bring it on. I'm Tsurugi, by the way.⏎From the EFG. I'm on a mission to defeat Aeon and end the Night,⏎so I'm gonna need you to make way.

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: You don't say... Then I'll introduce myself, too. I'm Gordeau.⏎From Amnesia. Tonight you could call me the Harvester of Selflessness,⏎but I doubt we'll meet again either way.
